about.docs_content: Detailed guides on medical image processing algorithms, including image averaging, subtraction, and advanced morphology. Learn how to optimize your X-ray analysis workflow using our AI models.
about.privacy_content: Your privacy is our priority. We process medical images using secure, encrypted channels. No patient data or images are stored on our servers without explicit consent. All processing is done in real-time.
about.terms_content: X-Ray Vision AI is provided for educational and research purposes. While our AI models are highly accurate, they should be used as assistive tools and not as a replacement for professional medical diagnosis.
about.how_we_use_desc: We only use the uploaded images for processing and immediate feedback. We do not sell, share, or analyze your data for any other purposes. Your session data is cleared as soon as you close the browser.
about.disclaimer_desc: The information provided by X-Ray Vision AI is for informational purposes only. The user assumes all responsibility for the interpretation and use of any analysis provided by the application.

api.subtitle: Integrate X-Ray Vision AI capabilities into your own applications using our high-performance REST API.
api.note_1: Use multipart/form-data for all file uploads.
api.note_2: Images are returned as binary blobs. Set your response type to blob in your client.
api.note_3: All processing is stateless. We do not store any images after the response is sent.

contact.subtitle: Have questions about our medical imaging tools? Get in touch with our team of specialists.

docs.average_detail: Combines multiple images of the same subject to cancel out random electronic noise.
docs.subtract_detail: Highlights dynamic changes by subtracting a reference frame from the current exposure.
docs.shading_detail: Corrects sensor non-uniformity by dividing the raw image by a reference flat-field pattern.
docs.mask_detail: Uses binary masks to isolate anatomical structures of interest.
docs.normalize_detail: Rescales intensity values to cover the full [0, 255] range, maximizing visual dynamic range in underexposed X-rays.
docs.smooth_detail: Employs Gaussian, Median, or Bilateral filters to suppress high-frequency noise while preserving structural edges.
docs.sharpen_detail: Utilizes unsharp masking to amplify high-frequency components, making fine anatomical details more visible.
docs.contrast_detail: Advanced Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) for localized enhancement without artifacts.
docs.edges_detail: Uses Canny algorithm to identify structural boundaries, useful for automated feature extraction.
docs.morphology_detail: Applies Dilation and Erosion to remove small artifacts or bridge structural gaps in segmentations.
